I can't score these from benchmark data: I have no NAS-Bench-201 tables or tools here, so every number below is a prior, not an estimate from measured interactions. Interaction claims that must hold on all three datasets with a practical margin usually fail, so I've kept most values low. I've placed the few higher values on edge-4 claims, where the parent edge plausibly changes how much the upgrade matters.
